description: This file defines the 'NonexistentEntry' class implementing the 'Entry' interface for a cache system; it represents a singleton object indicating the absence of a cache entry, providing methods to retrieve revision info, value, existence status, and access to the singleton instance.

classes.name: NonexistentEntry
classes.description: A singleton implementation of 'Entry' representing a non-existent cache entry. It always returns false for 'exists()', throws an exception for 'getValueOrThrow()', and provides a static method to access the shared instance.

methods.name: getRevision
methods.description: Returns Long.MIN_VALUE to indicate no revision for a nonexistent entry.

methods.name: getValueOrThrow
methods.description: Throws NoSuchElementException to indicate absence of a value.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Returns false, confirming the entry does not exist.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of NonexistentEntry, parameterized for generic type T.
